山中无岁月。

时笙和凤辞一直在崖底待到她突破大乘，因为那些火焰的存在，时笙修炼起来其实并不困难。

大乘之后就是渡劫，这个就得完全看个人运气了。

大乘之后修为并不会在有明显增长，渡劫什么时候到，除了在渡劫之前会有提示，其余的就一概不知，有的人到了大乘之后，几百年，几千年没有等到渡劫也不是没有。

渡劫是急不来的，时笙也只能放弃，和凤辞出了那个她不知待了多久的崖底。

外面是一片荒芜，时笙把许久没上场的布丁放了出来。

布丁哼哧哼哧的不太乐意，但是被凤辞一瞪，麻溜的变大。

凤辞抱着时笙上去，完全没有要放开的意思，他和时笙在下面待了那么久，可是时笙百分之九十九的时间都是在修炼，他除了盯着她看，赶跑一些跑到他们四周的生物，就再也没有其他事做。

此时能抱着时笙，他才觉得心底空荡荡的地方被填满，怎么可能会放开她。

魔界比时笙想象的大，以布丁的速度飞了将近三天才飞出那片荒芜。

外面和修真界没什么区别，魔族也没有长得三头六臂，如果不是他们使用的法术是魔族特有的，乍一看是没办法和人修区分的。

从一些魔族人那些听来的消息，现在魔界封印还没破，叶清秋应该还在修真界。

“我们要怎么出去？”凤辞下巴搁在时笙肩膀上，语带疑惑。

“破了魔界的封印啊，不然我们还能怎么出去？”时笙随意的道。

本宝宝又没有女主技能，不会徒手撕空间。

魔界封印反正都是要破的，早破晚破不都是一样的？

而且……

凤辞皱了皱眉，但也没说什么，她高兴就好，就算她要在魔界称王，他也会把王位捧到她面前。

魔界封印在一处湖泊，原主记忆中有当初魔族破解封印的方法，只是她没想到，她到的时候，魔族的人已经在布置了，而且还布置得差不多了……

“魔君，就差最后一步了。”魔族弟子恭敬又畏惧的看着站在湖泊前的男人。

男人一袭黑袍，上面绣着代表魔君的图腾，一头银丝随风飞扬，身姿笔挺，周身萦绕着一股冰冷生人勿进的压迫感。

魔界的魔君——君无期。

君无期望着没有半分涟漪的湖泊，“人找到了吗？”

魔族弟子沉默了三秒，才僵着声回答，“未曾。”

There is no time in the mountains.

Shi Sheng and Feng Ci stayed at the bottom of the cliff until she broke through the Mahayana. Because of the existence of those flames, it was not difficult for Shi Sheng to practice.

After the Mahayana is to transcend tribulations, this all depends on personal luck.

There will be no significant growth in cultivation after the Mahayana. When the tribulation will arrive, except for the reminder before the tribulation, the rest is not known at all. After reaching the Mahayana, it is not impossible that some people do not wait for the tribulation for hundreds or thousands of years.

There was no rush to overcome the tribulation, so Shi Sheng had no choice but to give up, and He Feng resigned from the bottom of the cliff where she had been staying for who knows how long.

It was a deserted place outside, and Shi Sheng released Pudding, who had not played for a long time.

Pudding hummed unhappily, but when Feng Ci glared at him, he became numb.

Feng Ci carried Shi Sheng up, with no intention of letting go. He and Shi Sheng had been down there for so long, but Shi Sheng spent ninety-nine percent of her time practicing. Apart from staring at her and chasing away some creatures that ran around them, he had nothing else to do.

Now that he could hold Shi Sheng in his arms, he felt that the empty space in his heart was filled. How could he let her go.

The demon world was bigger than Shi Sheng imagined, and it took nearly three days to fly out of the desolate area at the speed of pudding.

The outside world is no different from the world of cultivation, and the demons don't have three heads and six arms. If it weren't for the fact that the spells they use are unique to the demons, they would be indistinguishable from human cultivators at first glance.

According to the news from some demon clan members, the seal of the demon world has not been broken yet, and Ye Qingqiu should still be in the cultivation world.

"How are we going to get out?" Feng Ci rested his chin on Shi Sheng's shoulder, speaking with confusion.

"We broke the seal of the demon world, otherwise how could we get out?" Shi Sheng said casually.

This baby doesn’t have the skills of a heroine, so he can’t tear apart space with his bare hands.

The seal of the demon world has to be broken anyway, isn't it the same if it is broken early or late?

And...

Feng Ci frowned, but didn't say anything. As long as she was happy, even if she wanted to be king in the demon world, he would hold the throne in front of her.

The demon world was sealed in a lake. The original owner's memory contained the method used by the demons to break the seal. However, she did not expect that when she arrived, the demons were already making arrangements, and the arrangements were almost complete...

"Demon Lord, we are just at the last step." The demon disciple looked at the man standing in front of the lake with respect and fear.

The man wore a black robe with a totem representing the Demon Lord embroidered on it. His hair was made of silver threads flying in the wind, his posture was upright, and there was a cold and oppressive feeling around him that kept strangers away.

The Demon King of the Demon Realm—Jun Wuqi.

Jun Wu looked forward to the lake without any ripples, "Have you found the person?"

The demon disciple was silent for three seconds before replying stiffly, "Never."
